WJP Color Palettes

Source: R/utils.R
wjp_palette.Rd

wjp_palette() returns the color palettes used across World Justice Project visualizations, and wjp_colors() returns them as named vectors. All WJPr chart functions fall back to the categorical palette when no color vector (cvec) is supplied, so charts stay on-brand by default.

Usage

wjp_palette(n = NULL, palette = c("categorical", "report"))

wjp_colors(palette = c("report", "categorical"))

Arguments

n

Integer. Number of colors to return. If NULL (default), the full palette is returned. For convenience, a palette name can be passed as the first argument, e.g. wjp_palette("report").

palette

String. "categorical" (default) or "report".

Value

A character vector of hex color codes. wjp_colors() and the report palette return named vectors.

Details

The categorical palette contains nine colors, ordered so that the first three (violet, teal-blue, orange) provide maximum contrast for small categorical sets, followed by the Rule of Law Index factor colors:

OrderHex codeName
1#482d8bviolet (primary)
2#2894aateal (secondary)
3#f26b21orange (contrast)
4#137b3fgreen
5#869d3bolive
6#0f9581teal_green
7#1a74b6blue
8#8f2e8cmagenta
9#555659gray (neutral)

The report palette holds the colors of the WJP country reports (e.g., Paths to Justice), named by role:

NameHex codeUsage
main#575796Country series, headers, averages
eu#A8A8C8Comparison series (EU Average)
eu_text#7D7DA8Text of the comparison series
track#E5E8E8100% background track
text#1A1A1ABody text
highlight#B200AASecond series of perception/experience charts
grid#D0D1D3Grid lines
node#8E9393Neutral nodes (sankey)
excluded#C4C8C8Excluded flows (sankey)
box#F2F3F3Note boxes
note#7D7DA8Notes
delta#4B4B7ADifferences between cards
card_low#ECECF4Low end of the sequential scale

When more categorical colors are requested than the palette holds, the palette is interpolated with grDevices::colorRampPalette().

See also

scale_fill_wjp_seq() for the sequential report scale.

Examples

# Full palette
wjp_palette()
#> [1] "#482d8b" "#2894aa" "#f26b21" "#137b3f" "#869d3b" "#0f9581" "#1a74b6"
#> [8] "#8f2e8c" "#555659"

# First three colors for a small categorical set
wjp_palette(3)
#> [1] "#482d8b" "#2894aa" "#f26b21"

# Report colors, by role
wjp_palette("report")
#>      main        eu   eu_text     track      text highlight      grid      node 
#> "#575796" "#A8A8C8" "#7D7DA8" "#E5E8E8" "#1A1A1A" "#B200AA" "#D0D1D3" "#8E9393" 
#>  excluded       box      note     delta  card_low 
#> "#C4C8C8" "#F2F3F3" "#7D7DA8" "#4B4B7A" "#ECECF4" 
wjp_colors()[["main"]]
#> [1] "#575796"
